verdict.rationale: Fellow documents the source side of this workflow. Webhooks fire on events such as an AI note being generated, and the API lists action items with filters and an updated_at change window, so an agent can pull each meeting's action items with assignees and due dates. However, no native Linear, Jira or Asana integration and no in-product rules engine are documented, so the integrator must build the receiver and the tracker-filing logic. Missing for 10: native connectors to Linear/Jira/Asana, a built-in trigger-action automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end filing flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: When an event happens (like an AI note being generated or an action item being completed), Fellow sends an HTTP POST request to the URL you specify with details about the event.
List action items with optional filters and pagination.
To page through a window of changes, combine `updated_at_start` with `order_by: updated_at_asc`.
action items with assignees and due dates
This enables you to build integrations that react immediately to changes in Fellow, without needing to poll for updates.
